products.code_info: All product with the "Best When Used By" dates between 25 OCT 2013 - 11 FEB 2014.
products.reason_for_recall: Some varieties of Kraft and Polly-O String Cheese and String Cheese Twist products may spoil before their "Best When Used By" code dates, leading to product discoloration. The affected products all have code dates from October 25, 2013 through February 11, 2014.
